title: Windows native recipe-services codegen records a WSL dependency path
body: The queued Release witness configured successfully but Ninja stopped before compilation: build.ninja recorded the new d9 RecipeElementKinds.cs dependency as \mnt\c\Users\liory\AppData\Local\VIXEN\kernel-codegen\... while the command uses /mnt/c/...; the pinned source file exists. VIXEN/codegen/CMakeLists.txt:855 adds the WSL-form _recipe_element_kinds_source_run directly to DEPENDS instead of a native dependency path. Suggested consolidation: centralize WSL command-argument and native Ninja-dependency conversion for every recipe input, with a native Release smoke gate. Tier luna: one CMake dependency-graph fix plus a native witness; effort S.

title: Live queue elastic host-CPU parser rejects admitted VIXEN builds
body: The queued WSL Release build reached 980/1400 actions, then box-queue-core failed with unexpected argument 'true' (exit 70); recovery required UT_QUEUE_HOST_CPU_WSL=0. The facade/queue should provide one stable host-CPU invocation for admitted builds.

title: Pinned kernel snapshots omit the documented Unity analyzer provisioning wrapper
body: Native codegen materialization failed because the pinned snapshot lacked tools/ensure-unity-analyzer.sh; a direct queued dotnet build of SDFNodeGenerator.csproj with -p:DeployUnityAnalyzer=true was required and succeeded. Consumer setup should provision the exact pinned analyzer stamp through one available documented route.

title: Native VIXEN configure skips the no-new-mutex gate when bash or python3 is absent
body: The queued native Release configure printed bash/python3 not found and skipped the no-new-mutex gate; the build then proceeded. The native setup should provision the gate's interpreter or fail explicitly so Release witnesses cannot silently omit this check.
